opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Early bio pressure with Punisher Grenades, fast expansion via Orbital Command, and double Barracks production.
supporting_facts: The opening has a 55.9% winrate across 454 games.
All games in the opening have first_upgrade_observed (rate 1.0 vs baseline 0.018), indicating Punisher Grenades is consistently researched.
Second production building is observed in 72.9% of games (baseline 52.8%), showing a focus on double Barracks.
The medoid sequence shows early Barracks, then Gas, then second Barracks, followed by bio units and Punisher Grenades upgrade, and finally Orbital Command.
